description: i009 (SNAPSHOT=s02, BRANCH=sysctl-unbounded-knob) complete. Reported 3 variants of security-relevant sysctl knobs parsed without bounds, all verified against their actual consumers: (1) net/sctp/sysctl.c:265-270 net.sctp.addip_noauth_enable — writable boolean controlling the SCTP AUTH requirement for ASCONF/ASCONF-ACK (consumers net/sctp/sm_statefuns.c:3910-3911 and 4053 gate `!net->sctp.addip_noauth && !chunk->auth` on this int; sm_make_chunk.c:2017 returns early; input.c:1278 lookup gate) registered via bare proc_dointvec with no extra1/extra2 while sibling security knobs in the same table use proc_dointvec_minmax with SYSCTL_ZERO/SYSCTL_ONE — any nonzero int silently enables no-auth ADD-IP mode (medium confidence, CAP_NET_ADMIN-gated, policy-posture weakening). (2) net/ipv4/sysctl_net_ipv4.c:1387-1391 net.ipv4.tcp_challenge_ack_limit — RFC 5961 mitigation knob via bare proc_dointvec; consumer net/ipv4/tcp_input.c:4054-4066 assigns INT_MAX the meaning 'mitigation disabled' and computes `(ack_limit + 1) >> 1` and get_random_u32_inclusive(half, ack_limit + half - 1) on the unvalidated int, so 0/negative/INT_MAX writes collapse or disable challenge-ACK throttling (medium confidence). (3) net/xfrm/xfrm_sysctl.c:30-34 net.xfrm.xfrm_larval_drop — per-netns IPsec knob via bare proc_dointvec; net/xfrm/xfrm_policy.c:3253 branches on it as boolean to hard-drop (-EREMOTE) SA-less traffic (low confidence). Safe classifications with consumer evidence: crypto/fips.c fips_enabled (mode 0444 read-only), net/ipv4/sysctl_net_ipv4.c cipso_* and net/ipv6 calipso_* cache knobs (<=0 guards at cipso_ipv4.c:298-302 and calipso.c:272), apparmor sysctls (0600 + CAP_MAC_ADMIN gate in apparmor_dointvec), yama ptrace_scope (correct minmax+lock pattern), xprtrdma rdma_pad_optimize (4-byte/boolean, sole tree-wide maxlen type-mismatch hit from the 961-entry multiline scan), tcp_fastopen (bitmask consumers), gc_thresh/max_size and other memory/performance knobs (out of branch scope). Bounded limitations: drivers/ subtree entries name-triaged only, no runtime testing (snapshot not buildable in sandbox), and findings are enforcement-posture variants without the seed's uninitialized-memory defect. Final artifact at agent-state/findings/i009.json with snapshots_checked=["s02"], 3 findings, 12 candidates, 4 limitations.
